hotspots.title: Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's agreement to purchase Russian diesel has sparked severe bipartisan pushback from US senators and widespread anger from Ukrainian leadership. Trump escalated the row by publicly attacking Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, telling him to 'get a new president,' while claiming an unverified energy ceasefire.
hotspots.affect: A high-stakes geopolitical narrative combining accusations of foreign betrayal with direct personal attacks between political leaders generates maximum outrage.

hotspots.title: Trump Administration Legal Battles
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to immediately cease airing $20 million in taxpayer-funded promotional TV ads, ruling them illegal political misuse. Meanwhile, Trump's Justice Department launched antitrust investigations targeting major television networks that suspended press pool coverage after the administration banned selected journalists.
hotspots.affect: Escalating legal warfare over state-funded propaganda and administration retaliation against news networks drives intense media polarization.

hotspots.title: Frp Populist Surge & Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) reached a landmark 33.2% in national polls, taking the top spot overall and securing 53% support among voters under 30. However, party leader Sylvi Listhaug continues to slam mainstream media framing while local party transparency scandals in Tromsø erode voter trust.
hotspots.affect: Triumphant narrative of establishment political displacement clashes with media grievance and internal accountability disputes.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance are conducting a series of high-energy midterm campaign rallies in swing and key states. At a Tennessee rally, Trump made headlines by promising $5,000 annual cash payments to all adult US citizens if Republicans win congressional majorities.
hotspots.affect: Audacious populist economic promises combined with campaign tour excitement generate strong emotional buy-in among supporters.

hotspots.title: Jordan Bardella Antisemitism Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National president Jordan Bardella launched legal actions against investigative outlet Mediapart over reports linking him to historic antisemitic messages. However, new media reports from Libération contradicted Bardella's legal defense claims, intensifying scrutiny on the far-right leader.
hotspots.affect: Severe moral charges threatening the legitimacy of a major political figure trigger defensive legal battles and intense press focus.
